title: Amos Riley's band and other jobs; instruments
summary: Amos Riley played parties; he also played with Kid Rene, Willie Pajeaud and Robichaux; he had a B-flat tenor.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: Can you tell us some more about Amos Riley's band, where they played?
Well, uh, Amos Riley, he used to play for different parties, you know. And, uh, nobody played, you know, big dance hall or nothing. Yeah.
Mostly private parties. Yeah, yeah, parties, see.

He used to get those lawn parties at the time. Okay. And, uh, played with Rene a couple of times, that long part. Kid Rene? Yeah, Kid Rene. And, uh, his brother was playing drums. Then I played with, uh, Pajot. Willie Pajot.
And I played with, uh, I played with Robichot at, uh, at, uh, Palace, uh, couple of times.
The theater. Yeah, yeah. Uh, what instrument did you play all those bands with, uh, those? Still playing it? I played with, uh, still playing it.
Still playing it? I played with, uh, with Amos Riley. But, you know, when I started playing with Lewisty Man, I had my B Tenor. The B Tenor. Yeah. When did you take up the bass?
